info.name: Ascott MCP xAPI - all tool calls (T-02 to T-08)
info.description:
Every tool call of the ODX backend xAPI (asc-mcp-odx-backend-xapi), with tests.

| Tool | Endpoint |
|---|---|
| T-02 get_property_details | POST /api/v1/property-details |
| T-03 get_service_offerings | POST /api/v1/service-offerings |
| T-04 get_room_rate_details | POST /api/v1/multi-room-details |
| T-05 get_promotions | POST /api/v1/promotions |
| T-06 compare_properties | POST /api/v1/compare-properties |
| T-07 compare_rooms_rates | POST /api/v1/compare-rooms |
| T-08 create_booking | POST /api/v1/create-booking |

Every request sends a fresh X-Correlation-ID and future dates (check-in today + 21, three nights). Tests check the status, the JSON body, the echoed correlation ID, the error envelope on errors, and on a 200 the required keys of the tool's schema. The first T-04 request saves a room code and rate code that T-07 and T-08 reuse; the '00 Journey' folder runs the calls in conversation order.

Generated by postman/build_collection.py: edit that script, not this file.
